verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a compliance-oriented deployment path. Document AI is positioned for compliance-first organizations with secure on-premises deployment and a public Trust Center, and OCR 4 can run in a single container so document data stays in your environment for residency and compliance. Self-hosting is an indirect way to control retention, but the pack never mentions zero-data-retention for the hosted API, SOC 2, or HIPAA/BAA options. missing for 10: documented zero-retention policy for uploaded documents, SOC 2 attestation, HIPAA/BAA availability, independent corroboration of compliance handling for medical records.
